groups.title: 1. System and bootstrap
groups.intro: Feature enablement first, then hostname, system/DNS settings, login banner and NTP.

groups.title: 2. AAA, users and management
groups.intro: Local users, TACACS+/RADIUS server settings and hosts, and the NX-API management interface.

groups.title: 3. Interfaces
groups.intro: Physical and logical interface attributes, LLDP and UDLD.

groups.title: 4. Layer 2 (VLANs, VTP, LACP, vPC)
groups.intro: VLANs, VTP, access/trunk switchports, LACP, port-channels and vPC. cisco.nxos 14.0.0 has no dedicated spanning-tree module.

groups.title: 5. Layer 3 routing
groups.intro: VRFs, L3 interfaces, static routes, prefix lists, route maps, OSPFv2/v3, BGP, BFD, HSRP and VRRP.

groups.title: 6. Multicast
groups.intro: IGMP, IGMP snooping and PIM (global, interface and RP address).

groups.title: 7. VXLAN EVPN
groups.intro: Anycast gateway MAC, EVPN control plane, NVE interface / VTEP, VNI membership and EVPN VNI settings.

groups.title: 8. Security and ACLs
groups.intro: IPv4/IPv6 access lists and their interface bindings.

groups.title: 9. QoS
groups.intro: cisco.nxos 14.0.0 ships no dedicated QoS module. Use cisco.nxos.nxos_config (group 11) for QoS policy CLI.

groups.title: 10. Monitoring, logging and SNMP
groups.intro: Syslog, SNMP server and model-driven telemetry.

groups.title: 11. Operations and utility
groups.intro: Facts, show commands, raw config, file copy, NX-OS install, RPM, snapshots, rollback, maintenance mode (GIR), ping and reboot.

groups.title: 12. SAN / Fibre Channel
groups.intro: VSANs, FC interfaces, device aliases and zones/zonesets. These modules state in their own documentation that they target Fibre Channel (MDS / Nexus FC) platforms.

groups.title: 13. Other
groups.intro: Modules that do not fit the groups above. Nothing is guessed into another group. Empty in cisco.nxos 14.0.0.
